channel.title: Premium Times Nigeria - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Premium Times Nigeria (premiumtimesng.com)

item.title: Zenith Bank appoints new Executive Director
item.description: The appointment is consistent with the Bank's tradition and succession strategy of grooming leaders from within and will further strengthen the Bank's Executive Management.

item.title: Entrepreneurs champion women’s economic empowerment at West Africa Business Summit
item.description: The speakers urged a shift towards a broader understanding of business success beyond financial gains.

item.title: Opay to establish cybersecurity laboratory in Nigerian university
item.description: “To show how seriously we take this project, representatives of Hunter Flex Intercoms Construction Company, the firm to implement the project, are with us on this visit.”

item.title: Policy, funding gaps top agenda as experts meet on maternal health in Africa
item.description: The aim of the dialogue is to identify practical pathways for accelerating progress toward the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) related to maternal and newborn survival.

item.title: 2027: Support group for Mbah’s reelection inaugurates ward coordinators for Igbo-Eze South
item.description: Ugo Ferdinand Ukwueze, the chairman of Igbo-Eze South Local Government Area, who welcomed Mr Okonkwo and other dignitaries to the area, said that the gathering provided yet another opportunity for the Igbo-Eze South leaders and people to reaffirm their unalloyed support for Governor Mbah’s administration.

item.title: BetJara Casino welcome bonus now offering 100% up to ₦100,000
item.description: BetJara’s Casino welcome bonus is designed to double your initial deposit. This means that whatever amount you deposit as a new user is matched 100%, up to a maximum of ₦100,000.

item.title: ADC releases executive structure list to deepen grassroots participation, accountability
item.description: The ADC says the structure outlines a multi-layered leadership framework designed to improve coordination, participation and accountability within the party.

item.title: El-Rufai objects to appointment of judge in ICPC corruption case
item.description: The defence argued that a conflict of interest may occur because a petition previously filed by Mr El-Rufai against the judge is currently pending before the National Judicial Council (NJC).

item.title: Terrorists kill security officers, civilian in Kebbi ambush
item.description: The security personnel were reportedly on a mission to monitor and curb insurgent activities in the region when their vehicle was targeted.

item.title: ﻿Nigeria unveils HIV prevention plan, shifts focus beyond treatment
item.description: The launch is a response to evolving infection patterns and a move to address gaps in the country’s HIV response.

item.title: International Friendlies: Injury knocks out Super Eagles defender
item.description: Defensive options still available to Chelle include Semi Ajayi, Zaidu Sanusi, Bruno Onyemaechi and Igoh Ogbu, who are expected to step up in Bassey’s absence.

item.title: Police arrest Akwa Ibom village head with AK-47 rifle
item.description: “The command’s intention is to ascertain the source of the firearm, determine the suspect’s motives, and apprehend other possible accomplices,” a police spokesperson said.

item.title: ‘My divorce from Patrick Doyle was none of your business’ — Ireti Doyle shuts down critics
item.description: PREMIUM TIMES reported that Ireti in January 2023 confirmed that her marriage to her now ex-husband had officially ended.

item.title: Court adjourns El‑Rufai’s N1 billion fundamental rights suit again
item.description: Mr El-Rufai’s rights suit had previously stalled on 3 and 11 March due to different early-stage challenges and was rescheduled to today (Wednesday).

item.title: Court nullifies CBN’s takeover of Union Bank, says regulator acted beyond powers
item.description: The court nullified the entire regulatory intervention, including capitalisation process carried out by the CBN-appointed interim board.
